name: Configurable Recent repos count in the repo picker
description: The repo picker now shows 5 recent repositories by default (up from a hardcoded 3), and the count is a user pref editable in Settings → Behavior. Setting it to 0 hides the Recent section.

steps.title: The pref: recentRepoCount
steps.body: A new `recentRepoCount` field on `UserPrefs`, defaulting to **5**. `getPrefs()` already merges stored prefs over the defaults, so prefs files from older builds pick up the new field without a migration.

callouts.body: 0 is a meaningful value — it hides the Recent section entirely rather than being clamped up.

steps.title: Renderer store plumbing
steps.body: Mirrors how `maxDiffLines` flows: an `app.recentRepoCount` field hydrated in `init()`, plus a `setRecentRepoCount` action that persists via `state:setPrefs`.

callouts.body: Invalid input falls back to the current value instead of 0 — an accidental empty field should not silently hide the Recent section.

steps.title: Repo picker reads the setting
steps.body: The hardcoded `RECENT_COUNT = 3` constant is gone; the Recent slice is sized by `app.recentRepoCount`. A count of 0 yields an empty slice, and the existing `recent.length > 0` guard already skips the header in that case.

steps.title: Settings UI
steps.body: A **Recent repositories** number input in Settings → Behavior, following the dialog's draft/save pattern: snapshot on open, clamp and compare on Save, only persist when changed.

steps.title: Changeset
steps.body: Patch release note for the desktop app.

-		commentsSidebarOpen: false

<script lang="ts">
	import { User } from 'lucide-svelte';
	import { buttonVariants } from './ui/button';
	import * as Avatar from './ui/avatar';
	import AccountSwitcher from './AccountSwitcher.svelte';
	import { actions, app, effectiveGithubAccount } from '$lib/store.svelte';
	import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

	// Shows the account the current project authenticates as (its pin, else the
	// app-wide default) and switches the project's account — same behavior as the
	// commit-box switcher.
	const account = $derived(effectiveGithubAccount());
</script>

<AccountSwitcher
	align="end"
	heading="Account for this project"
	selectedAccountId={account?.id}
	defaultAccountId={app.activeGithubAccount?.id}
	isPinned={!!app.activeRepo?.githubAccountId}
	onSelectAccount={(id) => actions.setRepoGithubAccount(id)}
	onUseDefault={() => actions.setRepoGithubAccount(null)}
	triggerTitle={account ? `This project uses ${account.login}. Click to switch` : 'Account'}
	triggerClass={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'ghost', size: 'icon-sm' }), 'rounded-full p-0')}
>
	{#snippet trigger()}
		{#if account}
			<Avatar.Root class="size-6">
				{#if account.avatarUrl}
					<Avatar.Image src={account.avatarUrl} alt={account.login} />
				{/if}
				<Avatar.Fallback class="text-[10px]">
					{account.login.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
				</Avatar.Fallback>
			</Avatar.Root>
		{:else}
			<Avatar.Root class="size-6">
				<Avatar.Fallback>
					<User class="size-3.5" />
				</Avatar.Fallback>
			</Avatar.Root>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</AccountSwitcher>

diff --git a/.changeset/pr-comment-base-ref.md b/.changeset/pr-comment-base-ref.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.changeset/pr-comment-base-ref.md
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@super-review/desktop": patch
+---
+
+Fix PR review comments failing with "could not be resolved". A branch with a PR is now diffed against the PR's actual base ref (`pr/<n>/base`, fetched from the PR's own base repo) instead of the local default branch, so the diff matches GitHub's PR and comments anchor to lines that are genuinely part of it. Also force-fetch the PR head snapshot, anchor comments to the reviewed commit, and surface a clearer message when a line truly isn't in the current diff.

---
"@super-review/desktop": patch
---

Fix PR review comments failing with "could not be resolved". A branch with a PR is now diffed against the PR's actual base ref (`pr/<n>/base`, fetched from the PR's own base repo) instead of the local default branch, so the diff matches GitHub's PR and comments anchor to lines that are genuinely part of it. Also force-fetch the PR head snapshot, anchor comments to the reviewed commit, and surface a clearer message when a line truly isn't in the current diff.

files.newContents:
---
"@super-review/desktop": patch
---

The repository picker's "Recent" section now shows 5 repositories by default (up from 3), and the count is configurable in Settings → Behavior — set it to 0 to hide the section entirely.
